verdict.rationale: The only audit-trail evidence is an API endpoint for changes to vendor objects, and the approval-policy docs cover AP bills, not S&E expenses. Neither shows a per-expense record of edits, approvals and policy checks. The S&E marketing line that transactions are 'automatically compliant' does not document any audit trail, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit
